longTitle: Saudi Arabia Is No Richer Than in 1990
sources: Sources: World Bank WDI (NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD, SP.POP.TOTL, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD, SM.POP.TOTL.ZS, NY.GDP.PETR.RT.ZS, ); Saudi Ministry of Human Resources (HRSD, Dec 2025) and GASTAT Labour Force Survey; IMF crude oil production via FRED (KWTNGDPMOMBD, SAUNGDPMOMBD); PACI/CSB Kuwait population by nationality (via Gulf Labour Markets, Migration and Population programme); GAStat Saudi Arabia (population 2024); Kuwait Central Statistics Administration wages (via AGBI, March 2025); Norsk Petroleum and NBIM (Government Pension Fund Global); Kuwait Investment Authority.
music_credits: Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.

clips.title: Saudi Arabia is no richer per person than in 1990 #Shorts
clips.desc: The average American's output rose by three quarters. The average Saudi's didn't move.

clips.title: Kuwait was richer than America. Then this happened #Shorts
clips.desc: Output per person, adjusted for prices: almost $80k in 2006, about $48k in 2025.
